# On-device recipes

> Device-verified recipes for adding on-device AI to an existing iOS or Android app. Each page answers one developer question in its first 300 words, then leads to a recipe with the dependency line, the file to copy, the model file with its sha256, a verify command with its expected output, and the devices it was verified on with dates.

Numbers are measurements on named devices with dates; there are no estimates. Each recipe's source of truth is the INTEGRATION guide in the repository that ships the code; this site mirrors it and fails CI on drift. Maintainer handle: john-rocky. Last verified 2026-09-05.

## Questions

- [Can I run a PyTorch model on Android without going through ONNX?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/main/docs/pytorch-model-on-android-without-onnx.md): yes; litert-torch (torch.export to .tflite, no ONNX, no TensorFlow), ExecuTorch and ONNX Runtime measured on one conv + transformer model, parity within 7.5e-7 of PyTorch, the LiteRT CompiledModel GPU rank-4 and fp16 rules, quick start for all three routes.
- [Can LiteRT-LM run models other than Gemma?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/main/docs/litert-lm-models-other-than-gemma.md): yes; the list of ungated litert-community .litertlm bundles other than Gemma, read from the Hugging Face API with base model, license and files; Recipe 2 (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct offline chat in an existing Android app, Pixel 8a numbers); when llama.cpp, MLX or Apple's Foundation Models are the better fit.
- [How do I run a fine-tuned Hugging Face model on iPhone?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/main/docs/fine-tuned-hf-model-on-iphone.md): convert with hf-to-litertlm (supported families, what is refused), load with swift-litert-lm LiteRTChat; Recipe 3 on one representative fine-tune, verified on a Mac (M4 Max) with the iPhone row pending; cancel, release and the one-turn limit of Qwen3-template bundles.

## Recipes

- [recipes.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/main/recipes.json): machine-readable index of every recipe; schema at [recipe.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/main/schemas/recipe.schema.json).

- [Background removal (ormbg) in an existing Android app, on the GPU](https://github.com/john-rocky/LiteRT-Models/blob/main/ormbg/INTEGRATION.md): LiteRT CompiledModel 2.2.0 (`com.google.ai.edge.litert:litert`), gpu; Pixel 8a, Android 16, build CP1A.260505.005 (SDK 36), 2026-09-05: GPU: 246 ms per frame for the model, 361 ms end to end, 246/246 ops on the GPU Verify: `./gradlew :app:connectedGpuDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=com.ormbg.BgRemoverTest`. Machine-readable: [recipe.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/LiteRT-Models/main/ormbg/recipe.json). Converted and verified by john-rocky; measurements https://github.com/john-rocky/LiteRT-Models/blob/main/ormbg/INTEGRATION.md#7-verified--unverified; commit john-rocky/LiteRT-Models@a0f5c01; issues https://github.com/john-rocky/LiteRT-Models/issues. Status: verified.
- [Offline chat with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct in an existing Android app (LiteRT-LM)](https://github.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/blob/main/android-llm-chat/INTEGRATION.md): LiteRT-LM 0.16.1 (`com.google.ai.edge.litertlm:litertlm-android`), cpu; Pixel 8a, Android 16, build CP1A.260505.005 (SDK 36), 2026-09-05: CPU: 10.48 tokens/s decode, 55.4 tokens/s prefill, 0.67 s to the first token; GPU: 13.8 tokens/s decode, 71.5 tokens/s prefill, 0.5 s to the first token Verify: `./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.injected.androidTest.leaveApksInstalledAfterRun=true`. Machine-readable: [recipe.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/main/android-llm-chat/recipe.json). Converted and verified by litert-community (Google AI Edge) published the bundle; integration and verification by john-rocky; measurements https://github.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/blob/main/android-llm-chat/INTEGRATION.md#7-verified--unverified; commit john-rocky/on-device-recipes@086a791; issues https://github.com/john-rocky/on-device-recipes/issues. Status: verified.
- [A fine-tuned Hugging Face model in an existing iPhone app (hf-to-litertlm + swift-litert-lm)](https://github.com/john-rocky/swift-litert-lm/blob/main/docs/recipe-hf-finetune-to-iphone.md): LiteRT-LM via swift-litert-lm (LiteRTChat) v0.15.0 (xcframeworks pinned by Package.swift), gpu; Mac Studio (Apple M4 Max, 128 GB), macOS 27.0 (26A5416b), 2026-09-05: GPU: 142.7 tokens/s decode, 469.2 tokens/s prefill, 2.2 s to the first answer, 1,411 MB footprint; CPU: 33.3 tokens/s decode, 95.2 tokens/s prefill, 11.4 s to the first answer, 1,107 MB footprint Verify: `python3 -m venv lt && lt/bin/pip install "litert-lm==0.17.0" && lt/bin/litert-lm run --from-huggingface-repo mlboydaisuke/Qwen3-0.6B-Code-Expert-LiteRT model.litertlm --prompt "What is 17 + 25? Answer briefly." --thinking false --temperature 0 --top-k 1`. Machine-readable: [recipe.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/swift-litert-lm/main/docs/recipe.json). Converted and verified by john-rocky; measurements https://github.com/john-rocky/swift-litert-lm/blob/main/docs/recipe-hf-finetune-to-iphone.md#7-verified--unverified; commit john-rocky/swift-litert-lm@09f04f1 (tag 0.2.0); john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm@5ffe9ee; issues https://github.com/john-rocky/swift-litert-lm/issues. Status: verified.
